metadata.name: ww-paginator
metadata.description: A pagination navigation component that displays page numbers with previous/next buttons. It can be linked to a paginated source (table view or collection) for automatic pagination, or used with custom pagination settings (total, limit, offset).
features: Automatic pagination linked to a table view or collection source
Custom pagination mode with configurable total items, items per page, and offset
Page change events with context (page, offset, limit, total)
Customizable previous/next button icons and page number text elements
Smart navigation display with ellipsis separators for large page counts
Does not support infinite scroll or load-more patterns
Does not support page size selection (items per page is a fixed setting)

properties.name: useCustomPagination
properties.description: Enable custom pagination mode instead of linking to a paginated source (table view or collection). When true, you must provide paginatorTotal, paginatorLimit, and paginatorOffset manually.

properties.name: paginatedSourceId
properties.description: The ID of the paginated source to link to. Format is 'tableView:{id}' or 'collection:{id}'. Only used when useCustomPagination is false.

properties.name: paginatorTotal
properties.description: Total number of items to paginate. Only used when useCustomPagination is true.

properties.name: paginatorLimit
properties.description: Number of items per page. Only used when useCustomPagination is true.

properties.name: paginatorOffset
properties.description: Current offset (number of items to skip from the beginning). Only used when useCustomPagination is true.

events.name: change
events.description: Triggered when the user navigates to a different page (via previous, next, or direct page click).

slots.name: paginatorText
slots.description: Use a ww-text directly, il will be automatically repeated for each visible page link in the navigation. DO NOT EDIT THE TEXT OF THE ELEMENT, IT'S AUTOMATICALLY GENERATED. But you can custom the styles as needed. The state named 'active' has to be set in states config and used in the styles to set the active page number style.

slots.name: paginatorPrev
slots.description: Use a ww-icon directly, it will be automatically hidden when the user is on the first page.

slots.name: paginatorNext
slots.description: Use a ww-icon directly, it will be automatically hidden when the user is on the last page.

specifications: Link to a table view or collection via paginatedSourceId for automatic pagination management
Use custom pagination mode (useCustomPagination: true) for manual control with total, limit, and offset
The change event provides a 1-based page number and 0-based offset
Previous/next buttons are automatically hidden when at the first/last page
